issues.display_title: Issue #84: Add unique project_key slug to projects for the public live route
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 16/07/26

✅ Implementation: Project Public Share Key Implementation

Scope

Adds a unique public project_key to every project so frontend routes can use a short public key instead of exposing project UUIDs.

Model

File: src/models/models.go

  • Added Project.ProjectKey.
  • GORM tags enforce unique index and not-null schema.
  • JSON field is project_key.

Key Generation

File: src/action/v1/project/key.go

  • Added allowed alphabet:
abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789
  • Excludes ambiguous characters: 0, O, 1, l, I.
  • Added GenerateProjectKey() using crypto/rand.
  • Added IsValidProjectKey() for key validation.
  • Added unique-collision detection helper.

Project Create

File: src/action/v1/project/create.go

  • Project creation generates project_key server-side.
  • Unique key collisions are retried internally.
  • Client create body does not accept project_key or projectKey.

Project Responses

File: src/action/v1/project/shared.go

  • Project API responses include project_key.

Migration and Backfill

Files:

  • cmd/migrate/main.go
  • migrations/202607160001_project_public_share_key.sql

Changes:

  • Added migration directive:
-- +migrate BackfillProjectKeys;
  • Backfill runs in Go through the migration runner.
  • Existing projects get keys generated with crypto/rand.
  • Backfill checks DB collisions before assigning keys.
  • Duplicate existing keys are repaired.
  • Backfill verifies count(*) == count(DISTINCT project_key) before constraints are applied.
  • SQL migration adds the column, runs the Go backfill, sets NOT NULL, then creates the unique index.

Run with:

make migrate

or:

go run ./cmd/migrate -- up

Verification

Relevant verification passed:

go test ./cmd/migrate ./src/action/v1/project -count=1

Assignee: Pebi Sandi Pratama — Developer

Description

Add a public share key to every project so the FE live route can move from /live/{projectId} to map-thru.com/v/{key} (FE counterpart task on the FE repo).

  1. New field project_key on the Project model (src/models/models.go) — short random slug, unique and required (uniqueIndex, not null).
  2. Alphabet — a–z, A–Z, 0–9 excluding ambiguous characters 0, O, 1, l, I. Suggested length: 8 chars (~47 bits with the 57-char alphabet).
  3. Generation — on project create, generate server-side with crypto/rand; retry on unique-collision. Never accepted from client input.
  4. Backfill — migration (in migrations/) adds the column and backfills a key for all existing projects before adding the NOT NULL + unique constraints.
  5. Public resolve — the public live/floorplan endpoint used by the live route must accept the key (lookup by project_key) so the FE can render /v/{key} without exposing project UUIDs.

Acceptance Criteria

  • project_key column exists: unique, not null, indexed; returned in project JSON as project_key
  • Keys use only the unambiguous alphabet (no 0, O, 1, l, I) and are generated with crypto/rand
  • Every existing project gets a key via migration; migration is idempotent
  • Creating a project always yields a key; unique collision retried, not surfaced as error
  • Public live-route lookup works by project_key
  • Key is server-generated only — no create/update endpoint accepts a client-supplied key

Dependencies

None (FE route change depends on this)

issues.display_title: Issue #85: Public live endpoint: resolve project detail by project_key (published only)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 16/07/26

✅ Implementation: Public Live Endpoint Implementation

Scope

Adds a public live endpoint that resolves a published project's floorplan detail by project_key.

Shared Floorplan Serializer

File: src/action/v1/floorplan/shared.go

  • Extracted floorplan response construction into buildFloorplanResponse(project).
  • Shared by both existing floorplan detail and new live endpoint.
  • Preserves MinIO/object-storage URL rewrite:
    • shared.UseObjectStorage()
    • shared.ObjectKey()
    • shared.ObjectURL()

Existing Floorplan Endpoint

File: src/action/v1/floorplan/get.go

  • Keeps existing GET /v1/floorplan/:id UUID-only behavior.
  • Does not resolve project_key.
  • Does not add published-only guard, preserving editor preview behavior.
  • Uses the shared serializer.

New Live Endpoint

File: src/action/v1/floorplan/live.go

  • Added public live resolver.
  • Accepts only valid project_key.
  • Queries:
project_key = ? AND status = 'published'
  • Unknown key and unpublished project both return the same 404 body.
  • Response payload matches the existing floorplan detail serializer.
  • No user-scoped fields are returned.

Controller and Route

Files:

  • src/controllers/v1/floorplan/live.go
  • src/routes/v1/floorplan.go

Added route:

GET /v1/live/:key

The route is public and has no auth middleware.

Verification

Relevant verification passed:

go test ./src/action/v1/floorplan ./src/controllers/v1/floorplan ./src/routes/v1 -count=1

Assignee: Pebi Sandi Pratama — Developer

Description

The FE live route moves from /live/{projectId} to map-thru.com/v/{key} (key comes from #84). The BE needs a public resolve endpoint that returns the same detail payload as GET /v1/floorplan/:id, but looks the project up by project_key and only serves published projects.

  1. New public endpoint GET /v1/live/:key — registered without middleware.Auth(), same as the existing public GET /v1/floorplan/:id (src/routes/v1/floorplan.go).
  2. Lookup by project_key (column added in #84), not by UUID.
  3. Published guard — only projects with status = "published" are served. Unknown key and unpublished project must both return 404 with an identical body, so the endpoint does not leak whether an unpublished project exists.
  4. Response payload identical to the current floorplan detail (src/action/v1/floorplan/get.go): location, uploadedFiles, floorConfigs, generatedTwin, canvasData, activeLevelId, etc. Extract/reuse the existing serializer from the floorplan Get action — do not duplicate it.
  5. No user-scoped data in the response (no user_id, no member info); no cookie/session required.

Note: the existing GET /v1/floorplan/:id currently has no published check — leave its behavior unchanged in this task (the editor preview relies on it); the guard applies to the new key-based endpoint only.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /v1/live/:key is public (no auth) and returns the same payload shape as GET /v1/floorplan/:id for a published project
  • Lookup is by project_key; unknown key returns 404
  • Project with status != "published" returns 404 with a body identical to the unknown-key case
  • Serializer is shared with the existing floorplan Get action, not copy-pasted
  • Response contains no user_id or other user-scoped fields

Dependencies

  • #84 — project_key column, generation, and backfill
